title: From Self-Worth to steadier practice
subtitle: A deliberate path through self-worth
description: Guru restores worth by placing identity inside grace, humility, and belonging to the One. This path starts with short guidance, opens the topic fully, and then stays long enough with Gurbani to change pace.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Praise and nearness belong together in the life of the humble servant.
heroSource.lifeApplication: You do not need status to be held close.
